# Change the project it is working on

`write.file.project` — **write** × **file** at **project** reach (the working tree or workspace it was pointed at). Family: filesystem. Effect: **recoverable from a backup, a history or a revert, at a cost**.

## Granted by 5 of 9

| Profile | Control on the path | Evidence | Via |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Claude Code — web container](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-code-remote/ccr-container/index.md) | ● none | observed | shell (Bash) |
| [Claude Code — local · confirm off](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-code/local-confirmations-off/index.md) | ● none | derived | shell (Bash), files (Read, Edit, Write) |
| [Claude Code — local · confirm on](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-code/local-default/index.md) | ● none | derived | shell (Bash), files (Read, Edit, Write) |
| [Claude Desktop — local tools](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-desktop/default/index.md) | ● none | derived | local files and commands (when enabled) |
| [GitHub Actions — hosted runner](../../../map/grants/github/actions-runner/ci/index.md) | ● none | observed | the job's shell |

## What narrows it

**The setting:** a review before merge

**What it costs:** a reviewer's time

**Tier after:** setting

## In the mandates

- **wanted** by [A coding assistant on my machine](../../../map/mandates/coding-assistant-on-my-machine/index.md)
- **wanted** by [A coding assistant in a container on the web](../../../map/mandates/coding-assistant-in-a-container/index.md)
- **wanted** by [The desktop app, with local tools switched on](../../../map/mandates/desktop-app-with-local-tools/index.md)
- **wanted** by [A CI job on a hosted runner](../../../map/mandates/ci-job/index.md)
